name: BAD condition DATE
source:
This is a game where you enjoy a date with a boyfriend you’re already close to.
This time, the date takes place in bad weather, under the rain.
Enjoy the soothing sound of rain and the mature jazz BGM.

[Translated from [url=http://lllakolll.web.fc2.com/BADcondDATE/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
这是一款让你与已然亲密的男朋友享受约会的游戏。
这次约会恰逢坏天气，在雨中展开。
请享受舒缓的雨声与成熟的爵士背景音乐。

[译自[url=http://lllakolll.web.fc2.com/BADcondDATE/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
